label: prop:q-ns-nonlinear-uniqueness
title: Nonlinear estimates and uniqueness for the $q$-Navier--Stokes system
html:
Proposition. Nonlinear estimates and uniqueness for the q-Navier--Stokes system

Let (\mathbf{C}, A, \tau) define a QOU anchored at substrate parameter q > 1. Let v represent a divergence-free solution to the q-NS system spanning initial energy E_0 = \lVert v_0 \rVert_A^2, and set C_q = (\sum_k [k]_q^{-2})^{1/2} as the categorical Sobolev constant.

(a) q-Ladyzhenskaya inequality. The advection operator B(v) = \mu \circ (v \otimes \nabla_q v) obeys

  \lVert B(v) \rVert_A
   \leq 
  C_q\lVert v \rVert_A\lVert d_q v \rVert_A.

(b) Enstrophy bound. The enstrophy \Omega(t) = \lVert d_q v(t) \rVert_A^2 satisfies

  \frac{d\Omega}{dt}
   \leq 
  \Lambda_q\Omega,
  \qquad
  \Lambda_q = \frac{C_q^2E_0}{\nu_q} - \nu_q  <  \infty.

In particular, \Omega(t) \leq \Omega(0)e^{\Lambda_q t} unconditionally for all t \geq 0, so the enstrophy remains finite at every finite time.

(c) Uniqueness. If v_1, v_2 represent two exact solutions with v_1(0) = v_2(0), then v_1(t) = v_2(t) uniformly for all t \geq 0.
